item.title: In Situ Polymerized Main/Side-Chain Bifluorinated Cross-Linked Polyether Electrolytes for High-Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت پلی‌اتر شبک‌ای دوفلورینه (PTFMO-BEP) با پنجره اکسایشی بالای ۵٫۵ ولت و SEI غنی از مواد معدنی، چرخه‌پذیری پایدار باتری‌های لیتیوم-فلز با کاتد NCM811 تا ۴٫۷ ولت را ممکن می‌سازد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a bifluorinated cross-linked polyether electrolyte with −CF2– backbone segments and −CF3 side chains, enabling a >5.5 V window and anion-derived inorganic-rich SEI. Significance: dendrite-free Li plating, 85.6–91.5% retention at 4.3–4.5 V, stable 4.7 V operation, and 510.1 Wh kg–1 pouch cells, advancing practical high-energy Li metal batteries.
🏷 polyether electrolyte · lithium metal battery · in situ polymerization · fluorinated electrolyte · solid electrolyte interphase

item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using BDFO to force a trifunctional monomer into V-shaped 1D zigzag chains (CityU-31), leaving pendant aldehydes for postsynthetic functionalization. Significance: cyano-functionalized CityU-31-CN serves as a stable sodium-ion battery cathode, delivering 160 mAh g⁻¹ and >10,000 cycles, establishing crystalline 1D COFs as versatile, modifiable energy-storage platforms.
🏷 covalent organic framework · sodium-ion battery · cathode material · Knoevenagel condensation · cyano functionalization
